reason: Trader describes a basket of 10-15 evolving setups adapted to market/sector conditions plus heavy emphasis on preparation, risk/trade management and psychology rather than any single concrete long-side rule set.
style: swing trading with day trading overlay
timeframe: multi-day to multi-month swings plus intraday

setup.rule: Perform weekly market and sector analysis to identify money flow and build watchlist of 50-150 stocks
setup.quote: every week I do a sector analysis to see where the money is is Flowing we talked about money flow I'm really focusing on that and from there I'm building an overall watch list

setup.rule: Narrow daily to 5-15 stocks to stalk for setups
setup.quote: every evening or in the morning I'm trying to narrow it down to five or you know five to 15 stocks somewhere in there uh that I'll be watching during the day to see if they set up

entry.rule: Pre-plan entry range for each watched stock
entry.quote: with every one of these stocks uh I have a plan written out where I have the the entry range I have the stop range and I have my target range

stop.rule: Place stops considering natural volatility, support levels and where others place stops to avoid stop-gunning; sometimes wait for remount after stop gunning
stop.quote: thinking about where everybody else is placing their stops and making sure I'm not placing it right at that level

exits.rule: Pre-plan target range; avoid micromanaging once in trade (set it and forget it)
exits.quote: you have this plan you've done the hard work already and we were talking about this you know the hard work is in the preparation so you've done the hard work you know what you should be doing here uh so you set the trade you have it laid out and then really just forget about it

sizing.rule: Pre-calculate position size from planned risk amount and stop distance
sizing.quote: I only want to risk $1,000 so if I have a $10 stop I can only take this many shares so that's all laid out already for me

market_filter.rule: Bias direction (long/short) from overall market analysis; prefer stocks leading the market
market_filter.quote: 70 or 80% of a stocks move is the market uh so I want to be in stocks that are generally unless it's earnings based or something like that I I want to be in stocks that are in line and leading the market

ambiguities.issue: No single fixed setup or numeric parameters given; setups evolve over time
ambiguities.assumption: method is discretionary and cannot be coded as daily-testable strategy
